links.outcome: Ophthalmologists' reported barriers to AI adoption, including lack of training
links.effect: Lack of training was the most cited barrier (20.5%); 49.6% reported no knowledge of specific AI tools; 75.1% interested in AI education; only 7.2% reported regular use.
links.quote: Key barriers included lack of training (20.5%), implementation costs (16.5%), and reliability concerns (12.9%).

unlisted_practices: Integrating AI education into medical curricula and structured online training formats for ophthalmologists

screen.reason: Cross-sectional survey of 622 ophthalmologists regarding their perspectives, barriers, ethical concerns, and adoption of AI in clinical practice.
